values.name: low
values.description: Weak confidence; treat as tentative and challengeable.

values.name: medium
values.description: Moderate confidence; use, but verify assumptions.

values.name: total
values.description: Colloquial maximum confidence; equivalent to very strong author commitment.

values.name: low
values.description: Useful but not central to the current pass.

values.name: normal
values.description: Default importance for the current pass.

values.name: high
values.description: Important; should noticeably shape the answer.

values.name: critical
values.description: Must strongly shape the answer or block progress if ignored.

values.name: blocking
values.description: Blocks the current pass until addressed.

values.name: non-blocking
values.description: Known issue, but safe to proceed for now.

values.name: deferred
values.description: Intentionally left for a later pass.

values.name: current
values.description: Applies to the current implementation or current pass.

values.name: future
values.description: Preserve for future work; do not implement now by default.

values.name: planned
values.description: Accepted direction, but not done yet.

values.name: deprecated
values.description: Known stale direction or no longer preferred.

values.name: exploratory
values.description: Use for exploration, not final commitment.

values.name: inline
values.description: Applies only to the wrapped text.

values.name: following
values.description: Applies to the following block or region.

values.name: previous
values.description: Applies to the preceding block or region.

values.name: surrounding
values.description: Applies to the surrounding local passage.

values.name: reference
values.description: Reference material; do not modify unless instructed.

values.name: target
values.description: Primary place to work or change.

values.name: source
values.description: Input source for extraction or analysis.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Role is intentionally or currently unclear.

values.name: analyze
values.description: Examine and explain structure, tradeoffs, or implications.

values.name: refactor
values.description: Change structure without changing intended behavior.

values.name: port
values.description: Recreate behavior across languages, runtimes, or surfaces.

values.name: extract
values.description: Pull structured information from messy input.

values.name: generate
values.description: Produce an artifact from the seed.

values.name: decide
values.description: Model should make a reasoned decision.

values.name: explore
values.description: Model should explore options without forcing closure.

values.name: ask-if-blocked
values.description: Model may ask only if blocked by ambiguity.

values.name: answer-now
values.description: Attempt to answer in the current pass.

values.name: conflicts
values.description: Source is in tension with target.

values.name: requires
values.description: Source depends on target being true or done.

values.name: example-of
values.description: Source is an example of target.

values.name: counterexample-of

values.name: related-to
